reason: Paying only when I'm happy takes away the risk on the build, but I want someone who handles it all for years, and a one-man freelancer in Kuwait with no UK clients or reviews is a gamble on who looks after it after launch. I'd also end up on £43 a month forever, because I'm not going to deal with hosting myself.
objection: If he disappears or gets too busy in six months, I'm stuck paying £43 a month for a site nobody local can sort out, and I can't just pop round to someone to fix it.
would_change_my_mind: A couple of real UK small business owners, ideally in Manchester, I could ring or read reviews from saying he's still looking after their site months later, plus hosting folded into one simple yearly price.
